findings.failure_mode: Provider configuration is validated lazily on first use, so /api/ready reports healthy with a bad provider variable and the deploy healthcheck cannot fail closed (r3 opus#1, sol#2, terra#3).
An EnvError raised at first use surfaces as a 500 instead of a 503 'misconfigured' response (r3 opus#1/sol#2/terra#3, same cluster).
The .env.example claim about when the extent and hosts are validated is false for the shipped code (r3 opus#1 cluster).
findings.fix_evidence: hosts are validated at readiness (/api/ready returns 503

findings.failure_mode: TILES_PATH is frozen at module scope, so an override does not take effect and the accessor contradicts providerConfig's non-memoized contract (r3 sonnet#1).
PHOTON_BASE_URL is a full endpoint unlike every other provider base; the client should append /api to a bare host (r3 opus#5).
